support_contract.rare_definition: minor allele with MAC>=2 and MAF<0.01 in NatWGS-128 DISCOVERY_CORE
support_contract.validation_opening_enforcement: persistent fixed-key GCS claim created with ifGenerationMatch=0 plus a local O_CREAT|O_EXCL mirror; only the same run id and identical authenticated hashes may resume

estimands.A_transferability: number of sites selected in >=2/4 REF NAM units and observed in 2/2 VALID NAM units
estimands.B_additional_exact_variant_keys: number of A keys CHROM:POS:REF:ALT absent from the frozen baseline; this does not by itself establish a new locus
estimands.biological_replication: atomic units, not individuals, sites, haplotypes or allele copies

gates.P0: All split and phased-panel hashes match the 50/25/25 canonical run generated by 3b27440.
gates.P1: DISCOVERY_CORE, REF, VALID and TEST role lists are exact, unique and mutually disjoint.
gates.P2: Projected BCF headers equal their positive allowlists and contain zero SOURCE_TEST samples.
gates.P3: Source and all projections retain the same 43026 variant keys in the same order without genotype or variant filters.
gates.R0: M27E, raw WGS and baseline hashes match.
gates.R1: DISCOVERY uses exactly NatWGS-128 and reproduces the frozen rare definition.
gates.R3: The 507/447 exact-key baseline margin is reproduced.
gates.R4: REF membership, ancestry counts and four NAM units match the frozen split.
gates.R5: At least one site has observed usable support in >=2/4 REF NAM units; otherwise report inconclusive if units with missing genotypes could reach two.
gates.R6: Diagnostic B branch: report whether any R5 site is outside the frozen baseline and whether missing genotypes could change that margin; R6 does not block evaluation of A in VALID.
gates.V0: The REF support table and primary catalog authenticate by hash and a persistent atomic opening claim is verified before VALID is analyzed.
gates.V1: VALID contains exactly 306 samples, including 14 NAM in two units, and no TEST sample.
gates.V2: All 954 frozen keys are present in VALID without reorientation.
gates.V3: Callability is reported by unit; missing never counts as absence.
gates.V4: At least one REF-selected site is observed in both VALID NAM units.
gates.V5: At least one V4 site is outside the frozen baseline.

stop_rule.technical: Stop on any hash mismatch, SOURCE_TEST sample, use of the 21 quarantined samples in DISCOVERY, target reproduction failure or catalog change after REF.
stop_rule.A: If zero REF-selected sites appear in both VALID units, close transferability for this panel and chr22, unless missingness within an atomic unit makes the result inconclusive.
stop_rule.B: If A is positive but zero exact variant keys outside the frozen baseline pass, close only the additional-key claim; representation or reweighting would require a new design.
stop_rule.go: A positive B authorizes only support candidates and a later power-design decision, not LAI, simulation, training or TEST.
